# Mei Okubo

> Computer science transfer student at City College of San Francisco (completing IGETC and CS major-preparation coursework for a junior transfer, target Fall 2028), based in San Francisco, CA. Currently seeking Summer 2027 software engineering internships. Contact: business@meiorz.tech

www.meiorz.tech is a terminal-style personal site. The home page is plain HTML that works without JavaScript; the same content is available as markdown, and the resume as plain text, at the links below.

Summary:

- Main project: BlobGuard, an AI-assisted (agentic) engineering project on a real problem, cloud storage security: an MIT-licensed, open-source object-storage security posture scanner (Python command-line tool). Read-only: control-plane APIs only, never object contents. Every finding carries evidence and a remediation, and checks that cannot be confirmed report `error`, never `pass`. The Azure adapter is in progress (initial checks landing); AWS and GCP adapters are planned. Mei owns and directs it; it is built with an AI-assisted (agentic coding) workflow.
- Coursework completed: CS 110C (Data Structures and Algorithms in C++), CS 111C (Data Structures and Algorithms in Java), CS 270 (Computer Architecture and Assembly, MIPS).
- Experience: Computer Science Tutor / Teaching Assistant at City College of San Francisco since Sep 2024 (C++, Java, Python); ASL interpreter in STEM settings, working toward the CCSF ASL certificate (AMSL 2B), expected Fall 2027; Inspirit AI Ambassador and AI Scholar alum since Mar 2023.
- Skills: C++, Java, Python, SQL, Kotlin, Bash/Shell, MIPS Assembly; Linux, Docker, Azure, Terraform; Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions (CI/CD), automated unit and integration testing, debugging, CLI development, code review; ML fundamentals, NLP, transformer models (Google BERT), LLM-assisted development workflows.
- Certifications: AI Scholar, Inspirit AI (Apr 2022); Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals, AI-900 (Oct 2021); Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals, DP-900 (Aug 2021); Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals, AZ-900 (Jul 2021); Microsoft 365 Certified: Fundamentals, MS-900 (Jun 2021).
- Languages: English (fluent), Japanese (fluent), American Sign Language.
- Also a VTuber (anime-style avatar persona), preparing a stream relaunch.
- In progress: a creator automation app that schedules and cross-posts content for the VTuber relaunch through each platform's official APIs. Built in public.
- Also in progress (details coming soon): an Android app (Kotlin), AI-assisted security research, and an agentic terminal CLI app.

## Projects

- [BlobGuard](https://github.com/meiorz/blobguard): read-only object-storage security posture scanner (Python 3.12+, Terraform sandbox labs on Azure, GitHub Actions CI with automated tests); commands `scan`, `explain`, `list-checks`; JSON and Markdown reports; exit codes 0 clean, 1 failing finding, 2 bad usage, 3 could not run; built with an AI-assisted (agentic coding) workflow
- [meiorz.tech](https://www.meiorz.tech/): this site; accessible (WCAG 2.2 AA target), light and dark themes, strict Content Security Policy, no trackers, static on Azure Static Web Apps, built with an AI-assisted (agentic coding) workflow
- [Tweet sentiment classification with BERT](https://www.meiorz.tech/#projects): Inspirit AI Scholar project (Python, PyTorch); fine-tuned Google BERT on a labeled tweet corpus and presented the results and error analysis at Inspirit AI Demo Day
